No human clinical trial, observational cohort, or animal model evaluates raw honeydew melon (Cucumis melo Inodorus Group) for attention impairment in Parkinson's disease. Although Rounds 1 and 3 recorded minimal_signal leans for raw cantaloupe on fatigue, attention, and executive function based on two sponsor-funded trials of Extramel (Milesi 2009 PMC2757026; Carillon 2014 PMC4073155; opposed by three null melon-SOD trials), full-text inspection (PMC4073155 Section 2.1) confirms Extramel is a proprietary palm-oil-coated high-SOD juice concentrate bred from a specific French cantaloupe variety (C. melo var. cantalupensis) to prevent gastric SOD proteolysis (Intes 2012, PMID:22426094). Honeydew melon belongs to a distinct cultivar group (Inodorus) with different polyphenol/carotenoid chemistry (Sameed 2026, PMC12949660) and is eaten raw without enteric coating; therefore cantaloupe Extramel trials cannot be transferred onto raw honeydew melon. A mouse study of C. melo seed extract (Wahid 2020, PMID:33376745) tested non-edible seeds in healthy mice. Strict cultivar and preparation separation keeps attention impairment Unknown (Researched).

Maybe False (minimal_signal toward easing): three independent human clinical intervention studies directly testing plain dairy kefir or lyophilized kefir-fermented milk report statistically significant constipation relief outside Parkinson disease—Turan et al. 2014 (PMID:25599776, n=20 Rome II functional chronic constipation, 500 mL/d plain probiotic kefir 4 wk: increased stool frequency p<0.001, improved consistency p=0.014, decreased laxative use p=0.031, accelerated colonic transit in slow-transit subgroup p=0.013, bowel satisfaction p<0.001), Alves et al. 2022 (PMID:36360671, PMC9653948, n=52 controlled 8-wk homemade plain milk kefir: improved functional constipation vs control in both healthy adults p=0.003/paired p=0.025 and atopic adults p=0.033/paired p=0.038), and Maki et al. 2018 (PMID:29105976, n=42 persons with severe mental/physical disabilities, 2 g lyophilized kefir/meal 12 wk: significantly reduced constipation vs baseline with variable individual response)—supported by Bakirhan 2026 (PMID:41314291, n=65 RCT: reduced overall GI symptoms p<0.05), Fijan 2026 (PMID:41827605), Bui & Marco 2026 (PMID:40706019), North Caucasus traditional GI use, and Parkinson UK forum reports. Maybe True (limited_clinical_link toward worsening, directly calibrated with Round 3 cow milk precedent 0718): four controlled Parkinson clinical trials directly measure daily OFF/ON time under higher daytime versus lower or evening-redistributed dietary protein (Barichella 2006, PMID:16773618, n=18: balanced daytime protein increased total OFF 271 vs 164 min/d and postprandial OFF 79 vs 49 min, both p<0.0001; Tsui 1989, PMID:2494567, n=10 DB crossover: worse OFF hours; Carter 1989, PMID:2648188, n=5: 1.6 g/kg protein lowered ON time to 51% vs 77% evening-restricted; Eriksson 1988, PMID:3135513: LNAA/protein ON-OFF aggravation), directly bridged to plain fermented dairy kefir (~8-11 g casein/whey protein per 250 mL serving, e.g., Mohsenpour 2023 PMC10311804: 8 g/250 mL) via human crossover amino-acid kinetic RCTs showing fermented milk proteolysis delivers rapid, equal-or-GREATER postprandial circulating free essential/large-neutral amino acids (phenylalanine, leucine, isoleucine/BCAAs) than unfermented cow milk (Pimentel 2018, PMID:29788433, n=14 DB crossover: higher postprandial phenylalanine and 7 free AAs vs milk; Brown 2023, PMID:36989535: greater peak plasma leucine/BCAA AUC after fermented dairy vs skim milk; Milan 2024 n=20; Burke 2012 n=15; Tosukhowong 2016 n=32 PD whey BCAAs). Billows 2025 GoKiPH (n=26) and Conner 2020 KiwiC reported composite Total Mood Disturbance without isolated statistically significant anxiety reduction vs control, and no Parkinson's anxiety trial exists.

No clinical trial has evaluated raw kiwifruit on Parkinson's apathy severity. While Billows 2025 GoKiPH (n=26 non-PD mood-disturbed adults) reported improved subjective vitality (+17.3%, p=0.004) in an open-label crossover, vitality/energy in young mood-disturbed adults is distinct from Parkinson's neuropsychiatric apathy, and no PD apathy scale has been tested.

No human clinical study has tested raw kiwifruit on Parkinson's bradykinesia. Hegelmaier 2020 (PMID:32041265) tested a multi-food ovo-lacto vegetarian diet in PD without isolating kiwifruit, and Kitamura 2021 (PMID:33819745) tested hardy kiwi (Actinidia arguta—a distinct species) juice in MPTP mice.

Among non-Parkinson's dietary interventions, raw whole kiwifruit has the strongest replicated randomized clinical evidence in this batch—consistently EASING constipation and directly opposing the frozen worsening claim: Gearry 2023 (PMC10226473, n=184 international multicenter crossover RCT in NZ/Italy/Japan: 2 raw green kiwifruits/d vs 7.5 g psyllium x 4 wk increased CSBMs by +1.53/wk in FC [p<0.0001] and +1.73/wk in IBS-C [p=0.0003] and improved GSRS GI comfort [p<0.0001]), Chey 2021 (n=79 US comparative trial: 2 raw green kiwifruits/d improved CSBMs p<=0.003, stool consistency p=0.01, straining p=0.003, and bloating p=0.02 with fewest AEs and lowest dissatisfaction vs prunes/psyllium), Eady 2019 (n=32 SunGold crossover: CSBM 6.3 vs 4.5/wk p<0.05), Eady 2020 (n=38 SunGold with/without skin), Chan 2007 (n=33 FC: CSBM 2.2->4.4/wk p=0.013, faster colonic transit p=0.003), Rush 2002 (n=38 older adults >60 y), and Wilkinson-Smith 2019 (n=14 MRI crossover: higher ascending-colon water T1 p=0.029 and softer stools p=0.011), synthesized in the 2025 British Dietetic Association Guidelines (PMC12623288) and Van Der Schoot 2024 MA (+0.36 BM/wk over psyllium). Crucially, adversarial matrix trials show encapsulated kiwifruit EXTRACTS failed (Kindleysides 2015 n=40 null; Holtmann 2025 n=186 IBS-C missed primary endpoint p=0.798), proving the intact raw fruit matrix matters. Safety note: actinidin/latex-fruit IgE allergy risk (PMID:37569122; Vijayachandra 2025). Parkinson's UK forums (threads 14613 & 42308) show mixed community experience (smoothie regularity vs refractory PD constipation). Strictly capped at minimal_signal (50.005, Maybe False) per rubric v1 ONLY because no randomized controlled trial in diagnosed Parkinson's disease has yet been completed.

No clinical trial has evaluated raw kiwifruit on daily OFF time or levodopa pharmacokinetics in Parkinson's disease. Park 2020 (NCT04356573) studied actinidin effects on dietary beef-protein digestion kinetics in healthy adults, not levodopa absorption or PD OFF time.

Two human kiwifruit sleep studies directly evaluated daytime sleepiness/dysfunction and BOTH were NULL for raw whole kiwifruit: in Kanon 2023 (PMC10043399, n=24 acute crossover), fresh raw green kiwifruit did NOT significantly improve morning sleepiness versus water (2.6 vs 3.0, NS; only freeze-dried powder with skin did, p=0.013 vs water and p=0.034 vs fresh), and in Doherty 2023 (PMC10220871, n=15 elite athletes single-arm), PSQI Daytime Dysfunction did not significantly change (1.13 -> 1.00, p=0.48). No Parkinson's daytime sleepiness trial exists.

Several non-PD human studies of raw SunGold kiwifruit (2/day) indicate a modest mood-disturbance easing signal, led by Billows et al. 2025 GoKiPH (PMC12030757, n=26 mood-disturbed adults, randomized open-label crossover: 2 raw SunGold kiwifruits/d vs usual diet x 4 wk lowered POMS Total Mood Disturbance by 65.2% from 27.6 to 9.6, time-by-treatment p<0.001, treatment main effect p=0.07, while raising wellbeing +10.5% p=0.003 and vitality +17.3% p=0.004). Supporting studies include Carr 2013 (n=35 young men RCT: 2 vs 0.5 gold kiwifruit/d showed non-significant overall trends for TMD -35% p=0.06 and depression -32% p=0.063, reaching p=0.029 for TMD in the n=8 high-disturbance subgroup), Conner 2020 KiwiC / Fletcher 2024 smartphone timecourse (n=167/155: rapid mood/vitality gains within 4 days, though iAUC attenuated after adjustment), and Vlasiuk 2024 (n=20 single-arm uncontrolled: depression/fatigue p<0.05). Major adversarial and methodological caveats strictly constrain confidence to minimal_signal (50.005, Maybe True): Vorland 2022 (PMID:36235715) exposed mixed random/nonrandom allocation and group randomization in Conner 2020 (prompting a formal correction removing "Randomized" from the title, PMID:36235871); Kanon 2023 (PMC10043399, n=24 acute single-evening crossover) was NULL on the POMS Depression subscale (p=0.193); Billows 2025 was open-label, reported composite TMD rather than a standalone depression score, and carried industry PhD funding; and zero Parkinson's depression trials exist.

No clinical study has tested raw kiwifruit on REM sleep behavior disorder or dream enactment frequency in Parkinson's disease. Prior kiwifruit sleep studies (Lin 2011; Kanon 2023; Doherty 2023) measured general sleep quality/latency in non-PD cohorts without RBD endpoints, and Kanon 2026 examined pig brain bioamines only.

No clinical study has evaluated raw kiwifruit on Parkinson's drooling (sialorrhea). The only salivary mention is a single non-PD case report of allergic contact stomatitis with acute hypersalivation triggered by kiwifruit allergy (Zang 2022, PMID:35845480), an acute IgE/hypersensitivity reaction rather than a Parkinson's sialorrhea effect.
No clinical, observational, or preclinical study has tested raw kiwifruit on levodopa-induced dyskinesia in Parkinson's disease.
No clinical or experimental study has evaluated raw kiwifruit on Parkinson's dystonia severity.

The only identified human cognitive test of raw kiwifruit on executive function—Edwards 2015 master's thesis (n=20 healthy adults, archived in local kiwi notes)—found NULL between-group differences on incongruent Stroop interference (p=0.35) and choice reaction time (p=0.66). No Parkinson's executive function trial of raw kiwifruit exists.

No clinical study has evaluated raw kiwifruit on fall frequency or balance in Parkinson's disease. Rare anaphylactic collapse cases (Vijayachandra 2025) reflect IgE food allergy rather than Parkinson's postural falls.
